title: Computers as Bad Social Actors: Dark Patterns and Anti-Patterns in Interfaces that Act Socially
reasoning: The paper is fundamentally focused on the ethics of interface design, specifically identifying 'dark patterns' (manipulative design) and 'anti-patterns' (counterproductive design) in social computers. It explores how these systems subvert user autonomy, use deceptive emotional cues, and fail to treat users with respect, ultimately proposing a normative framework for ethical automated social interaction.
